result.title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
result.summary: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AURA，一种音频驱动的流式说话头像视频扩散模型：用滚动 KV cache 逐 chunk 因果生成，只依赖当前音频块而非多秒前瞻，并通过两阶段蒸馏（教师轨迹对齐、加反向模拟的 DMD）压缩扩散步数，使 1.3B 模型单卡实时输出 576p、5B 输出 720p。
AI.relevance_reason: 其滚动 KV cache 与 chunk 级滑动窗口因果注意力，以及「轨迹匹配 + 少步蒸馏」压缩计算的训练方案，可能为 LVR 中流式推理状态的缓存管理、受限计算下 latent 更新步数压缩提供可供核查的方法线索；但论文本身面向视频生成，与视觉证据筛选和推理决策无直接关联。
